item.title: Hands‑On Workshop Helps Professionals Build Personal AI Systems
item.description:
Hands‑On Workshop Helps Professionals Build Personal AI Systems

A new hands‑on workshop lets participants turn a repetitive work task into a personal AI workflow, requiring no technical background.

🔍 Overview

  • Turn one repetitive task from your real work into an AI workflow.
  • Build Your Personal AI System!
  • Most AI courses show you slides about what AI can do.

🛠️ How It Works

  • This is not a lecture.
  • This is a working session in a tiny group (max 4–5 people) where we sit down and build AI systems for your actual work.
  • You bring your daily friction.
  • We build the AI stack together.
  • Over the session, you will map out your workflow, find where AI actually saves time, set up tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw hands‑on, and leave with a working system you can use Monday morning.
  • Then you get a free follow‑up call to check your progress or fix what broke.

👥 Who Should Attend

  • No experience needed.
  • No technical background required.
  • You just need a challenge you want to solve or curiosity to learn latest tech.
  • This is for any job, any background.
  • If you have work that eats your time, you belong here.
  • Bring a problem.
  • Build a system.
  • One‑size‑fits‑all.

📍 Logistics

  • 📍 Location: May change due to capacity.
  • You will be informed in advance.

💬 Why It Matters

  • “I believe the more we let AI take care of the robotic aspects of our lives, the more time we have for the human parts of it.”

👤 Organizer Insight

  • I have founded 20+ businesses.
  • Some worked.
  • Most didn’t.
  • That is the point.
  • I test fast, fail fast, and keep what works.
  • Right now, I am deep in the world of AI, optimizing my stack for every task and would like to share that knowledge while learning.
  • and a few more as a founding partner or consultant.

#AIWorkshop #Productivity #NoCode #Automation

Source: AI Stack Lab
